Step 1: Apply power rule d/dx(x^n) = nx^(n-1)
Step 2: d/dx(2x^2) = 4x^1
Step 3: d/dx(7x^4) = 28x^3
Answer: 4x^1 + 28x^3

Step 1: Apply power rule d/dx(x^n) = nx^(n-1)

Answer: 24x^7 + 4x^1

Step 1: Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv'
Step 2: u = x^3, u' = 3x^2
Step 3: v = sin(x), v' = cos(x)
Step 4: dy/dx = 3x^2·sin(x) + x^3·cos(x)
Answer: 3x^2sin(x) + x^3cos(x)

questions.question: Differentiate: y = 5ln(7x)
questions.solution:
Step 1: d/dx[ln(kx)] = 1/x
Step 2: d/dx[ln(7x)] = 1/x
Step 3: Multiply by 5
Answer: 5/x

questions.question: Find dy/dx: y = 7e^(4x)
questions.solution:
Step 1: d/dx(e^(kx)) = k·e^(kx)
Step 2: d/dx(e^(4x)) = 4e^(4x)
Step 3: Multiply by 7
Answer: 28e^(4x)

questions.question: If x^4 + y^4 = 7, find dy/dx
questions.solution:
Step 1: Differentiate both sides
Step 2: 4x^3 + 4y^3(dy/dx) = 0
Step 3: dy/dx = -4x^3/(4y^3)
Answer: -x^3/y^3

questions.question: Use product rule: y = x^7 × sin(x)
questions.solution:
Step 1: Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv'
Step 2: u = x^7, u' = 7x^6
Step 3: v = sin(x), v' = cos(x)
Step 4: dy/dx = 7x^6·sin(x) + x^7·cos(x)
Answer: 7x^6sin(x) + x^7cos(x)

questions.question: Find dy/dx: y = sin(6x^7)
questions.solution:
Step 1: Chain rule d/dx[sin(u)] = cos(u)·du/dx
Step 2: u = 6x^7, du/dx = 42x^6
Step 3: dy/dx = cos(6x^7) × 42x^6
Answer: 42x^6cos(6x^7)

questions.question: Use product rule: y = x^3 × sin(x)
questions.solution:
Step 1: Product rule (uv)' = u'v + uv'
Step 2: u = x^3, u' = 3x^2
Step 3: v = sin(x), v' = cos(x)
Step 4: dy/dx = 3x^2·sin(x) + x^3·cos(x)
Answer: 3x^2sin(x) + x^3cos(x)
